derivedNotStored: Overview counts and priority band are computed from the same records the destination screens show.

Institution status is computed: no plan → awaiting payment; all plans ended → ended; pause present → paused; nearest live plan end within 15 days → ending soon; otherwise active. This is a presentation derivation, not a service rule.
Content is 'stuck' when it is with the Academic Reviewer and no reviewer has its course (or all experiments, or that experiment) in active scope.
